// diagnostic

E3108

Invalid unsafe option or obligation assertion.

What

Invalid unsafe option or obligation assertion.

Why

Unsafe proof vocabulary is closed and site-bound.

Fix

use only `obligations: .Track`/`.Skip` and `valid_ptr`, `aligned`, `no_alias` inside `#Unsafe`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E3108: tests/ui/unsafe_assert_outside_gate.stderr.

Error [E3108]: unsafe obligations can only be asserted inside `#Unsafe`
  --> tests/ui/unsafe_assert_outside_gate.jet:2:5
    |
  2 |     assert valid_ptr
    |     ^^^^^^
 Why: the assertion discharges one tracked low-level operation and has no ambient meaning
 Fix: move it immediately after an operation inside the audited gate
